summary.purpose: Load Policy Master Records from a sequential flat file into a VSAM Key-Sequenced Dataset (KSDS) for the TFG Mainframe Personal Lines system.
summary.high_level_narrative: The program initializes by opening the input sequential file (POLICY-IN) and output VSAM KSDS (POLICY-MASTER). It then enters a loop reading each input record until end-of-file. For each record, it validates that the policy number is not spaces. If valid, it moves all fields from the input record to the VSAM record structure and writes to the KSDS using the policy number as the primary key. Duplicate key errors are caught and counted. Finally, it closes both files and displays summary statistics: total records read, written, and errors encountered.
inputs: POLICY-IN (sequential flat file, assigned to POLIN, line sequential organization)
outputs: POLICY-MASTER (VSAM KSDS, assigned to POLYMAST, indexed organization, dynamic access, record key: POLICY-NUMBER)
key_transformations: Sequential file read with end-of-file detection
Field-by-field mapping from input record (POLICY-IN-REC) to VSAM record (POLICY-MASTER-RECORD) for 13 fields
VSAM KSDS write with duplicate key detection (INVALID KEY handling)
Counters for records read, written, and errors
key_dependencies: COBOL runtime environment for VSAM operations
business_rules: Policy number (PI-POLICY-NUMBER) must not be spaces; records with blank policy numbers are rejected and counted as errors
Policy number is the unique primary key for the VSAM KSDS; duplicate policy numbers are rejected and counted as errors

All 13 policy attributes are loaded without transformation: customer ID, agent ID, product code, policy type, effective date, expiration date, current status, payment frequency, policy term, written premium, earned premium, renewal date
Written premium and earned premium are stored as packed decimal (9(10)V99) preserving two decimal places

knowledge_profile.purpose: Load Policy Master Records from a sequential flat file into a VSAM Key-Sequenced Dataset (KSDS) for the TFG Mainframe Personal Lines system. The program reads policy records, validates the policy number is not blank, maps all fields directly to the VSAM record, and writes to the VSAM file with duplicate key detection.
key_logic: Initialize: Open input sequential file and output VSAM file, verify open status.
Loop: Read each record from POLICY-IN until end-of-file.
Validate: Check that PI-POLICY-NUMBER is not spaces; if invalid, increment error count and skip write.
Transform: Move all 13 fields from input record to VSAM output record (direct 1:1 mapping).
Write: Write the VSAM record; on duplicate key (INVALID KEY), display error and increment error count; on success, increment write count.
Close: Close both files and display summary statistics (records read, written, errors).
